numeric.method: Summarizes actual GPU output only. CPU rotates geometric normals for comparison and sums recorded GPU contributions. No CPU replacement of depth/normal/AO shader, no renderer, no writes.

conclusion: The known C10 secondary peak at these six actual shop rear-wall centers is removed: C11 GPU AO increases monotonically toward1, including .9159594 at304 -> .9626881 at313 ->1 at322. Both main contributors3/5 now decay by increasing h; broad distance cutoff remains1 at these points, so the old L attenuation rebound no longer drives them.
limits: Only six points and this frozen actual scene/camera; not universal AO monotonicity/normal correctness. Full50-row PNG statistics are in the separate view analysis.
Depth/normal/AO are actual GPU reads with new C11 functions, not CPU replacement. CPU merely serializes/sums GPU fields.
Geometry raycasts only corroborate nearest texel geometry and do not execute fragment clipping/alpha/depthWrite; old raster-vs-ray discrepancies remain possible.
No performance test or change to fixture/shader product. All transport cancellations retained, no rerun to green.
